what: ONEOK is one of the largest US midstream companies. It gathers and processes natural gas, moves natural gas liquids, refined products and crude oil through roughly 60,000 miles of pipeline, and operates marine export terminals.
customers: Gas and oil producers, refiners, petrochemical plants and fuel distributors.
money: gathering, fractionation and transport of NGLs
moat: An integrated NGL system from well to fractionator to export dock, which is almost impossible to assemble from scratch.
risks: Debt of about $28 billion built up through large acquisitions
Integration of Magellan, EnLink and Medallion is still in progress
Volumes depend on producer drilling plans
Commodity price exposure in some processing contracts
opportunities: Revenue grew about 55% last year as acquisitions were absorbed
A dividend yield near 5% with cost savings still to come from the deals
Export capacity expansion serves growing Asian demand
watch: Synergy capture from acquisitions and the debt-to-EBITDA ratio.
